name: Porto
summary: Porto combines a historic center declared a World Heritage Site with a significantly lower cost of living than Lisbon, without losing good digital connection or proximity to the sea. It offers a calmer and more authentic environment than the Portuguese capital, with a growing community of digital nomads and the same access to the Portuguese D8 visa.
